teaminternational.com: 64. The gap: broken links.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 16 internal links lead to an error.

The lesson for every team: Check your own links after each release, and fix or redirect every one that answers 404.

epssura.com: 40. The gap: form labels.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 161 form controls have no label.

The lesson for every team: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
